    AI Overview
    "One Shining Moment" is the iconic video montage that airs on CBS
    approximately 25–30 minutes after the conclusion of the NCAA Men's Basketball National Championship game. It traditionally marks the end of the college basketball season, setting tournament highlights to music, usually following the championship game on a Monday night. 
    • When it Airs: The song, performed by Luther Vandross, closes out the NCAA tournament coverage late Monday night/early Tuesday morning following the final game.
    • 2026 Timing: Following Michigan's victory over UConn on April 6, 2026, the 2026 montage was released in the early hours of April 7.
    • Significance: Created by David Barrett in 1986, it was originally intended for the Super Bowl but became the definitive March Madness highlight reel in 1987.
    • Content: The video montage, which can be viewed on the NCAA March Madness YouTube channel or through the March Madness Live portal, highlights key moments from the entire tournament, ending with the champions' celebration.
